## 更新内容

- 工作目录：更改路径后立即生效，无需重启；编码、预览等任务运行时会阻止切换，避免影响进行中的任务
- 下载与安装：支持从已下载的进度继续获取工具包，减少网络中断后的重复下载
- 设置引导：修复安装 vsrepo 插件时未完整准备前置依赖的问题
- VapourSynth 编辑器：修复旧状态可能覆盖当前标签页内容的问题

## Update Notes

- Workspace: path changes now take effect immediately without restarting; switching is blocked while encoding, preview, or other active tasks could be affected
- Downloads and setup: tool package downloads can resume from existing progress after network interruptions
- Setup guide: fix incomplete prerequisite preparation when installing vsrepo plugins
- VapourSynth editor: prevent stale state from overwriting the current tab contents
